# Aura gradient data

This directory vendors the canonical gradient catalog from
[CristianOlivera1/Aura](https://github.com/CristianOlivera1/Aura) at commit
`276792e97c1482159e928b39c2725e3c0eee946c`.

- `gradients.ts` is copied from `lib/gradients.ts` without changing the data.
- `LICENSE` contains the upstream MIT license and copyright notice.
- Vitrines-specific mapping lives in `src/auraColorPalettes.ts`.

When refreshing the catalog, update all three: the source file, the pinned
commit, and this notice.
